<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ears of the Forest](/Feats.aspx?ID=5418) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9)

</column>

---

Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings. When you [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301), if there are any willing [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) in the selected area, you can borrow their senses. Doing so lets you Seek with [scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) and [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) as [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) senses, along with any other senses appropriate to the animals in the area, at the GM's discretion.
name: Ears of the Forest
